rounds.response:
Adds an optional status query parameter to GET /api/tasks: when provided the results are filtered to tasks whose status exactly matches the value, when omitted behavior is unchanged, and unknown status values return 200 with an empty list.  
Controller: accepts optional "status" query param and forwards it to TaskService.listTasksForUser(userId, status) while preserving existing endpoint behavior for current callers.  
Service: adds an overloaded listTasksForUser(userId, status) that parses the string to TaskStatus, delegates to the appropriate repository method, returns Collections.emptyList() for unknown values, and keeps the original listTasksForUser(userId) delegating to the new overload.  
Repository: adds findByUserIdAndStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(userId, TaskStatus) in addition to the existing findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc.  
Tests: added JUnit5 + Mockito unit tests for the three cases — no status (calls findByUserId...), valid status (parses and calls status-aware repo), and invalid status (service returns empty list and controller responds 200 + []).
